description: This file defines the Number class within the SCSSPHP project, representing numeric values with optional units for processing in SCSS compilation. It includes methods for unit management, conversion, comparison, and serialization, serving as a core component for handling dimensioned values.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: Represents a dimensioned number with optional units, supporting operations like comparison, serialization, and unit coercion within the SCSSPHP compilation process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Number instance with a given dimension and associated units.

methods.name: getDimension
methods.description: Returns the numeric dimension value.

methods.name: getNumeratorUnits
methods.description: Returns the list of numerator units.

methods.name: getDenominatorUnits
methods.description: Returns the list of denominator units.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the Number object into a JSON-compatible format, outputting its SCSS representation.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a particular offset exists in the object's array access interface.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value at a specific offset in the object's array access interface.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Throws an exception as Number instances are immutable.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Throws an exception as Number instances are immutable.

methods.name: unitless
methods.description: Returns true if the number has no units.

methods.name: hasUnits
methods.description: Returns true if the number has any units.

methods.name: hasUnit
methods.description: Checks if the number has exactly the specified unit.

methods.name: unitStr
methods.description: Returns the units as a string, combining numerator and denominator units.

methods.name: valueInRange
methods.description: Returns the number's value if within the specified range; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: valueInRangeWithUnit
methods.description: Returns the number's value if within the specified range with a specific unit; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: assertNoUnits
methods.description: Ensures the number has no units, throws an exception if it does.

methods.name: assertUnit
methods.description: Ensures the number has the specified unit, throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: assertSameUnitOrUnitless
methods.description: Ensures this number's units are compatible with another number.

methods.name: coerce
methods.description: Returns a new Number coerced to specified units, potentially converting units.

methods.name: isComparableTo
methods.description: Checks if this number is comparable to another, considering units.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Checks if this number is less than another, considering unit conversion.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this number is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this number is greater than another.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this number is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: plus
methods.description: Returns a new Number representing the sum of this and another number.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Returns a new Number representing the difference between this and another number.

methods.name: unaryMinus
methods.description: Returns a new Number with the value negated.

methods.name: modulo
methods.description: Returns the remainder of division with another number.

methods.name: times
methods.description: Returns a new Number representing the product of this and another number.

methods.name: dividedBy
methods.description: Returns a new Number representing the quotient of this divided by another.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this number is equal to another, considering units.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number, formatted for SCSS output.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the output string of the number, enabling string casting.
